starter: Next.js 16.3.8 / React 19.2.8, same lockfile and starter as the Mistral browser rerun
browser: Playwright MCP 0.0.83, isolated Chromium, screenshots enabled, initial viewport 1440x960
prompt_policy: Original prompt with only assigned skill clause and free port substituted; no extra browser-use instruction or follow-up coaching
preflight: Separate unscored sessions confirmed assigned skill catalogs and successfully read a canvas-only screenshot
isolation: Separate profiles, personal instruction loading and memories disabled, unrelated skills excluded. Context isolation only; full filesystem and process access remained.
integration_changes: Root html/body converted to nested divs with corresponding scoped selectors to preserve font and custom-property inheritance
Global CSS scoped by gallery generator; native CSS modules retain native isolation
Tailwind source font and animation theme utilities materialized locally
Public assets and import aliases namespaced

Haiku taste numeric self-links point to gallery routes
generation_policy: No orchestrator edits to generated source during runs. Original completed sources retained outside the gallery; hash records describe files before import adapters.
timing: Concurrent sessions, not a controlled latency benchmark. Matching effort labels do not imply equivalent compute across providers.
run_caveats: The design-taste session ran a broad next-server process termination that interrupted the Anthropic session dev server; the Anthropic session restarted it without orchestrator coaching. Outputs were preserved.

Anthropic session reported lint/typecheck success but did not run a standalone production build. The gallery production build validates the imported version.
Design-taste retains model-chosen seeded Picsum photographs and placeholder product claims.
